race.comment: ANACONDA JONES (11) led and kicked away to score impressively last start at Belmont, winning by 2.1L over 1000m. Third-up now and out to 1100m doesn't look an issue, and he's drawn perfectly for his racing style.Tougher now but he's an exciting prospect to watch rise through the ranks. DELZEE (7) got the job done in good fashion last start, getting every chance and winning by 1.3L. Maps to get every chance in the run once again and his last start figure is very strong. His form may have been franked earlier in the card and he can repeat the dose. SPICY THANG (3) went to another level for the Andrews stable last campaign. She's had a sneaky trial coming into this and CJP sticks from that heat. Has options from the draw and can return on a winning note. HEZANGELIC (1) was solid first-up and the form out of that has already worked out. Can play a leading role.
